description: This file defines a PHP class 'Setting' in the Opencart admin startup namespace. The class manages the retrieval and application of configuration settings, including setting the timezone and syncing it with the database.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: A controller class responsible for loading and applying configuration settings during the startup process in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads settings from the model, applies them to the configuration, sets the timezone, and synchronizes PHP timezone with the database.
